/paths/~1account~1export/post/descriptio.en:
Everything the server keeps about the account, as one JSON file to save (`format` `scacelith-account-export`, `version` 1). The export records a security event (`account_exported`). The `notes` array of the document tells the player in plain English what is left out.

**Never in the export:** the password hash, the two-step verification secret and the recovery codes; any session or link token, or a hash of one; the anti-cheat's data (integrity level and score, anomalies, the analysis of the games, the weight of a report); the reports other players made about the player; the identities of moderators; other players' private data (opponents appear by their public name and rating, nothing tells whether another player was sanctioned, and no IP address that may be another person's is included).

**Re-authentication:** the password and, with two-step verification, an authenticator code or a recovery code. **Limits:** `account_export` (5 per hour per player, for the whole server; every attempt counts, failed ones included; checked first), then `reauth` and `reauth_user`. **Time limit:** 60 seconds.
/paths/~1account~1export/post/descriptio.text:
Alt, hvad serveren gemmer om kontoen, som én JSON-fil, der kan gemmes (`format` `scacelith-account-export`, `version` 1). Eksporten registrerer en sikkerhedshændelse (`account_exported`). Dokumentets array `notes` fortæller spilleren på letforståeligt engelsk, hvad der er udeladt.

**Aldrig med i eksporten:** adgangskodens hash, hemmeligheden til totrinsgodkendelse og gendannelseskoderne; ethvert sessions- eller linktoken eller en hash af et sådant; anti-snydesystemets data (integritetsniveau og score, anomalier, analysen af partierne, vægten af en anmeldelse); de anmeldelser, andre spillere har indgivet om spilleren; moderatorernes identitet; andre spilleres private data (modstandere optræder med deres offentlige navn og rating, intet afslører, om en anden spiller er blevet sanktioneret, og ingen IP-adresse, der kan tilhøre en anden person, er med).

**Fornyet godkendelse:** adgangskoden og, med totrinsgodkendelse, en kode fra godkendelsesappen eller en gendannelseskode. **Grænser:** `account_export` (5 i timen pr. spiller, for hele serveren; hvert forsøg tæller, også mislykkede; kontrolleres først), derefter `reauth` og `reauth_user`. **Tidsgrænse:** 60 sekunder.

/paths/~1account~1delete/post/descriptio.en:
Deletes the account; this cannot be undone.

- Every session is revoked at once: the token gets 401 `invalid_token` from then on.
- The user name becomes `deleted#<id>`, in the account and in every game record.
- These are erased: the e-mail address, the password hash, the two-step secret and recovery codes, the sessions and link tokens, the Google link, the anti-cheat's integrity record, and the IP addresses stored with security events.
- Ratings and games are kept. Games stay readable under the anonymous name, and `GET /players/{username}` answers 404 for the former name.

**Re-authentication:** the password and, with two-step verification, an authenticator code or a recovery code. **Limits:** `reauth`, then `reauth_user`.
/paths/~1account~1delete/post/descriptio.text:
Sletter kontoen; det kan ikke fortrydes.

- Alle sessioner tilbagekaldes med det samme: tokenet får derefter 401 `invalid_token`.
- Brugernavnet bliver til `deleted#<id>`, både i kontoen og i alle partiposter.
- Følgende slettes: e-mailadressen, adgangskodens hash, totrinshemmeligheden og gendannelseskoderne, sessionerne og linktokens, Google-tilknytningen, anti-snydesystemets integritetspost og de IP-adresser, der er gemt med sikkerhedshændelser.
- Ratinger og partier bevares. Partierne kan fortsat læses under det anonyme navn, og `GET /players/{username}` svarer 404 for det tidligere navn.

**Fornyet godkendelse:** adgangskoden og, med totrinsgodkendelse, en kode fra godkendelsesappen eller en gendannelseskode. **Grænser:** `reauth`, derefter `reauth_user`.

/paths/~1account~1games/get/description.en:
The signed-in player's games, newest first, filtered and paged, with the number of games matching the filter. Every query parameter is optional, and an empty value counts as absent.

Paging: pass the previous page's `next` as `before`; `next` is `null` on the last page. `total` counts the games matching the filter, across all pages.

**Limit:** `account_games`.
/paths/~1account~1games/get/description.text:

Sideinddeling: send den forrige sides `next` som `before`; `next` er `null` på den sidste side. `total` tæller de partier, der matcher filteret, på tværs af alle sider.

**Grænse:** `account_games`.

/paths/~1games~1{id}~1pgn/get/descriptio.en:
The same game as a PGN file: one game with `\n` line endings, and move text in lines under 80 columns. The answer is the same with or without a token.

Tags, in this order: `Event` (`<SERVER_NAME> rated <category>` or `<SERVER_NAME> casual <category>`), `Site` (`SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST`), `Date` (the UTC start date), `Round`, `White`, `Black`, `Result` (`*` for an aborted game), `UTCDate` and `UTCTime` (the start), `WhiteElo` and `BlackElo` (the ratings at the start, or `-`), `WhiteRatingDiff` and `BlackRatingDiff` (the changes, such as `+10` and `-10`, in every rated game, `+0` when the rating rules leave the rating where it was; a casual, custom or aborted game has neither), `TimeControl` (in seconds), `Termination` (a PGN standard value: `normal`; `time forfeit`, a flag fall, also when it ends in a draw; `abandoned`; `rules infraction`, a second illegal move or a fair-play forfeit; `unterminated`, an aborted game), `PlyCount`, `ScacelithGameId` (the decimal id).

Each move carries `{[%clk h:mm:ss.f] [%emt h:mm:ss.f]}`: the mover's clock after the move and the time charged for it, in tenths of a second (truncated). A value is left out when the record lacks it. After the last move, the end reason follows in words, then the result.

**Limit:** `public_read` (per player with a token, per client without).
/paths/~1games~1{id}~1pgn/get/descriptio.text:
Det samme parti som PGN-fil: ét parti med linjeskift `\n` og træktekst i linjer under 80 kolonner. Svaret er det samme med eller uden token.

Tags i denne rækkefølge: `Event` (`<SERVER_NAME> rated <category>` eller `<SERVER_NAME> casual <category>`), `Site` (`SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST`), `Date` (startdatoen i UTC), `Round`, `White`, `Black`, `Result` (`*` for et afbrudt parti), `UTCDate` og `UTCTime` (starttidspunktet), `WhiteElo` og `BlackElo` (ratingerne ved start eller `-`), `WhiteRatingDiff` og `BlackRatingDiff` (ændringerne, fx `+10` og `-10`, i alle ratede partier, `+0`, når ratingreglerne lader ratingen være uændret; et uratet, tilpasset eller afbrudt parti har ingen af dem), `TimeControl` (i sekunder), `Termination` (en standardværdi i PGN: `normal`; `time forfeit`, et flagfald, også når det ender remis; `abandoned`; `rules infraction`, et andet ulovligt træk eller et tab på grund af fair play; `unterminated`, et afbrudt parti), `PlyCount`, `ScacelithGameId` (det decimale id).

Hvert træk har `{[%clk h:mm:ss.f] [%emt h:mm:ss.f]}`: den trækkende spillers ur efter trækket og den tid, der blev fratrukket for trækket, i tiendedele sekunder (afkortet). En værdi udelades, når posten mangler den. Efter det sidste træk følger slutårsagen i ord og derefter resultatet.

**Grænse:** `public_read` (pr. spiller med token, pr. klient uden).

/paths/~1gif/post/summary.en: Make an animated GIF of any game sent as PGN
/paths/~1gif/post/summary.text: Lav en animeret GIF af et vilkårligt parti sendt som PGN

/paths/~1gif/post/description.en:
The same picture as `GET /games/{id}/gif` for any game sent as PGN text: a game saved by the game, an export of another site, a game typed by hand. Only the first game of the text is used.

- The PGN reader takes what the game's own reader takes: every PGN that this server writes and the usual exports of other sites (comments, variations, NAGs and clock annotations are skipped; move numbers and SAN read leniently; a `FEN` tag gives the start position unless `SetUp` is `"0"`).
- The names and ratings come from the `White`, `Black`, `WhiteElo` and `BlackElo` tags. Accented letters lose their accents, other characters outside printable ASCII become `?`, and long names are cut (48 characters). The result comes from the `Result` tag, else from the end of the move text. The `Termination` tag is shown unless it is `normal`: the final position then tells the story (checkmate, stalemate).
- This endpoint checks its body itself: an unknown field or a missing or non-string `pgn` answers 400 `invalid_request` with `field`; a wrong option answers 400 `invalid_option` (`delayMs` must be a JSON number, `coords` a boolean; `null` is refused).

**Session required:** the quotas count per account. **Limits:** as for `GET /games/{id}/gif`. **Body limit:** 135,168 bytes, whatever `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (the PGN as a JSON string, its escapes included). **Time limit:** 45 seconds by default.
/paths/~1gif/post/description.text:
Det samme billede som `GET /games/{id}/gif` for et vilkårligt parti sendt som PGN-tekst: et parti gemt af spillet, en eksport fra et andet website, et parti skrevet ind i hånden. Kun tekstens første parti bruges.

- PGN-læseren accepterer det samme som spillets egen læser: al PGN, som denne server skriver, og de almindelige eksporter fra andre websites (kommentarer, varianter, NAG'er og urannotationer springes over; træknumre og SAN læses tolerant; et `FEN`-tag giver startstillingen, medmindre `SetUp` er `"0"`).
- Navnene og ratingerne kommer fra tagsene `White`, `Black`, `WhiteElo` og `BlackElo`. Bogstaver med accent mister deres accent, andre tegn uden for printbar ASCII bliver til `?`, og lange navne afkortes (48 tegn). Resultatet kommer fra tagget `Result`, ellers fra slutningen af trækteksten. Tagget `Termination` vises, medmindre det er `normal`: så fortæller slutstillingen historien (skakmat, pat).
- Dette endpoint kontrollerer selv sin body: et ukendt felt eller et `pgn`, der mangler eller ikke er en streng, giver 400 `invalid_request` med `field`; en forkert indstilling giver 400 `invalid_option` (`delayMs` skal være et JSON-tal, `coords` en boolesk værdi; `null` afvises).

**Påkrævet session:** kvoterne tælles pr. konto. **Grænser:** som for `GET /games/{id}/gif`. **Grænse for bodyens størrelse:** 135.168 byte, uanset `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (PGN'en som JSON-streng, inklusive dens escape-sekvenser). **Tidsgrænse:** 45 sekunder som standard.

/paths/~1leaderboard/get/description.en:
The top 100 rated records of an official category with at least `minGames` (`PROVISIONAL_GAMES`) counted games, deleted accounts and confirmed cheaters left out. The server computes each board again at most every 10 seconds; `updatedAt` says when. One computation of a category runs at a time: meanwhile the other requests get the previous list, or wait for the computation when there is none yet.

**Limits:** only the per-address layer.
/paths/~1leaderboard/get/description.text:
De 100 bedste ratingposter i en officiel kategori med mindst `minGames` (`PROVISIONAL_GAMES`) talte partier, uden slettede konti og bekræftede snydere. Serveren beregner hver rangliste på ny højst hvert 10. sekund; `updatedAt` angiver, hvornår. Der kører én beregning ad gangen pr. kategori: imens får de andre anmodninger den forrige liste, eller de venter på beregningen, hvis der endnu ikke er nogen.

**Grænser:** kun laget pr. adresse.

/paths/~1reports/post/summary.en: Report the opponent of a recent game
/paths/~1reports/post/summary.text: Anmeld modstanderen i et nyligt parti

/paths/~1reports/post/description.en:
Reports the opponent of one of the player's own games that ended within the last 7 days. A report never changes a rating, a sanction or an integrity level by itself. It raises the review priority that moderators see, and, except for `abuse`, it asks for the engine analysis of the game.

A report of the same opponent for the same game gets the same answer and changes nothing; the answer never tells anything about the reported account. `GET /games/{id}` tells the game's players beforehand whether a report would be taken (`reportable`).

This endpoint checks its body itself, in the order `gameId`, `reported`, `category`, `comment`: a failure answers 400 `invalid_request` without `field`. Fields it does not know are ignored.

**Limits:** `reports` (per player), then `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) reports per player in 24 hours (429 `report_limit`).
/paths/~1reports/post/description.text:
Anmelder modstanderen i et af spillerens egne partier, der er afsluttet inden for de seneste 7 dage. En anmeldelse ændrer aldrig i sig selv en rating, en sanktion eller et integritetsniveau. Den hæver den prioritet for gennemgang, som moderatorerne ser, og undtagen ved `abuse` beder den om motoranalyse af partiet.

En anmeldelse af den samme modstander for det samme parti får det samme svar og ændrer intet; svaret fortæller aldrig noget om den anmeldte konto. `GET /games/{id}` fortæller partiets spillere på forhånd, om en anmeldelse ville blive modtaget (`reportable`).

Dette endpoint kontrollerer selv sin body i rækkefølgen `gameId`, `reported`, `category`, `comment`: en fejl giver 400 `invalid_request` uden `field`. Felter, det ikke kender, ignoreres.

**Grænser:** `reports` (pr. spiller), derefter `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) anmeldelser pr. spiller på 24 timer (429 `report_limit`).

/paths/~1reports/post/responses/202/desc.en: The report is received (or was already filed).
/paths/~1reports/post/responses/202/desc.text: Anmeldelsen er modtaget (eller var allerede indgivet).

/paths/~1reports/post/responses/403/desc.en: `report_not_allowed`: not the opponent of the reporter in a game that ended within the last 7 days.
/paths/~1reports/post/responses/403/desc.text: `report_not_allowed`: ikke anmelderens modstander i et parti, der er afsluttet inden for de seneste 7 dage.

/paths/~1reports/post/responses/429/desc.en: `report_limit` (`retryAfter: 3600`, with a `Retry-After` header): `REPORTS_PER_DAY` reports in the last 24 hours. `rate_limited`: the `reports` limit or the account budget.
/paths/~1reports/post/responses/429/desc.text: `report_limit` (`retryAfter: 3600`, med en `Retry-After`-header): `REPORTS_PER_DAY` anmeldelser inden for de seneste 24 timer. `rate_limited`: grænsen `reports` eller kontobudgettet.

/paths/~1reports/post/responses/503/desc.en: `server_busy` (the session lookup found the database locked), `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1reports/post/responses/503/desc.text: `server_busy` (sessionsopslaget fandt databasen låst), `timeout`. Også `server_busy` med `retryAfter` 2 til 5, når serveren er langt bagud (se introduktionen): anmodningen blev ikke udført.

/paths/~1reset-password/post/description.en:
The form of the reset page; it does what `POST /auth/password/reset` does, in one transaction: every device is signed out, a pending e-mail change is cancelled, the other reset links stop working, the address counts as confirmed and the owner gets a mail.

The link is checked first, then that both passwords are the same, then the password rules. When the server is busy, the form comes back with `Retry-After` and the link stays valid.

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_reset` (shared with `POST /auth/password/reset`).
/paths/~1reset-password/post/description.text:
Nulstillingssidens formular; den gør det samme som `POST /auth/password/reset`, i én transaktion: alle enheder logges ud, en afventende ændring af e-mailadressen annulleres, de andre nulstillingslinks holder op med at virke, adressen regnes som bekræftet, og ejeren får en e-mail.

Først kontrolleres linket, derefter at de to adgangskoder er ens, og derefter reglerne for adgangskoder. Når serveren er optaget, kommer formularen tilbage med `Retry-After`, og linket forbliver gyldigt.

**Grænser:** `auth`, derefter `auth_reset` (delt med `POST /auth/password/reset`).

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/2.text: Adgangskoden er skiftet, og alle enheder er logget ud.

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/5.en: The form again with `Retry-After` when the server is busy (the password hash queue, or the database stayed locked); the link stays valid. When the server is far behind (see the introduction), a "Server error" page with `Retry-After` (2 to 5) instead: nothing was run and the link stays valid. Also the handler timeout.

/components/securitySchemes/bearerAuth/d.en: A session token (`sct_` followed by 43 base64url characters) from a sign-in answer, in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The prefix is exactly `Bearer` (case-sensitive) and one space; a value that does not have it, or a token that is not 1 to 512 printable ASCII characters, answers 401 `invalid_token` like any other invalid token. An empty header counts as no header.
/components/securitySchemes/bearerAuth/d.text: Et sessionstoken (`sct_` efterfulgt af 43 base64url-tegn) fra et loginsvar, i headeren `Authorization`: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Præfikset er præcis `Bearer` (der skelnes mellem store og små bogstaver) og ét mellemrum; en værdi uden det, eller et token, der ikke består af 1 til 512 printbare ASCII-tegn, giver 401 `invalid_token` som ethvert andet ugyldigt token. En tom header regnes som ingen header.

/components/responses/PowRequired/descri.en: `pow_required`: solve the `pow` challenge and send the same request again with `pow: { challenge, nonce }`. `reason` says why: `required`, `malformed`, `signature`, `endpoint`, `network`, `expired`, `bits`, `work` or `replayed`.

/components/responses/TooManyRequests/de.en: `rate_limited` (a rate limit, the account budget, or the password hash queue) or `too_many_attempts` (a throttle of the account), with `retryAfter` and a `Retry-After` header.
/components/responses/TooManyRequests/de.text: `rate_limited` (en hastighedsgrænse, kontobudgettet eller hashkøen for adgangskoder) eller `too_many_attempts` (en drosling af kontoen), med `retryAfter` og en `Retry-After`-header.

/components/responses/TooManyRequests/co.en: Too many failures on this account
/components/responses/TooManyRequests/co.text: For mange mislykkede forsøg på denne konto

/components/responses/InternalError/desc.en: `internal_error`: an unexpected failure. The server logs it.
/components/responses/InternalError/desc.text: `internal_error`: en uventet fejl. Serveren logger den.

/components/responses/BadGateway/descrip.en: `sso_failed`: a wrong `state` or `iss`, or Google refused the code or sent an ID token that does not verify (a code or ID token of the other client, the game's or the website's, included). It never carries Google's text.
/components/responses/BadGateway/descrip.text: `sso_failed`: en forkert `state` eller `iss`, eller Google afviste koden eller sendte et ID-token, der ikke kan verificeres (også en kode eller et ID-token fra den anden klient, spillets eller websitets). Den indeholder aldrig Googles tekst.

/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable.en: `server_busy`, `busy` or `timeout`: try again after `retryAfter` when it is given.
/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable.text: `server_busy`, `busy` eller `timeout`: prøv igen efter `retryAfter`, når den er angivet.

/components/schemas/SecurityEvent/descri.en:
A security event. `ip` is given only for what was done while signed in, with the account's password (and second factor) or with a link mailed to its address: `register`, `email_verified`, `login`, `sso_login`, `sso_linked`, `sso_account_created`, `recovery_code_used`, `password_reset`, `password_changed`, `reauth_failed`, `mfa_setup_started`, `mfa_enabled`, `mfa_disabled`, `recovery_codes_regenerated`, `session_revoked`, `sessions_revoked_all`, `email_change_requested`, `email_changed`, `email_change_refused` and `account_exported`; every other kind has `ip: null`, and `ip` is erased after `RETENTION_IP_DAYS`.

`detail` keeps only these fields: `login`: `method`; `sso_login`, `sso_account_created`: `provider`; `sso_linked`: `provider` and `method` (`password`, or `password+totp`); `login_failed`: `failures`; `login_lockout`: `retryAfterMs`; `mfa_failed`: `attempts`; `recovery_code_used`: `remaining`; `reauth_failed`: `factor`; `session_revoked` and `sessions_revoked_all`: `reason`; `email_change_refused`: `reason`; `sanction_auto`: `kind`, `gameId`, `until`. A `moderator_action` event keeps only `{ action }`, for the actions `ban`, `unban`, `reset_mfa`, `verify_email` and `revoke_sessions` (the other moderator actions are left out). Every other kind has `detail: null`. The `rating_refund` events are left out: their points are in `ratingRefunds`.
/components/schemas/SecurityEvent/descri.text:
En sikkerhedshændelse. `ip` angives kun for det, der blev gjort som indlogget, med kontoens adgangskode (og anden faktor) eller med et link sendt til dens adresse: `register`, `email_verified`, `login`, `sso_login`, `sso_linked`, `sso_account_created`, `recovery_code_used`, `password_reset`, `password_changed`, `reauth_failed`, `mfa_setup_started`, `mfa_enabled`, `mfa_disabled`, `recovery_codes_regenerated`, `session_revoked`, `sessions_revoked_all`, `email_change_requested`, `email_changed`, `email_change_refused` og `account_exported`; alle andre typer har `ip: null`, og `ip` slettes efter `RETENTION_IP_DAYS` dage.

`detail` beholder kun disse felter: `login`: `method`; `sso_login`, `sso_account_created`: `provider`; `sso_linked`: `provider` og `method` (`password` eller `password+totp`); `login_failed`: `failures`; `login_lockout`: `retryAfterMs`; `mfa_failed`: `attempts`; `recovery_code_used`: `remaining`; `reauth_failed`: `factor`; `session_revoked` og `sessions_revoked_all`: `reason`; `email_change_refused`: `reason`; `sanction_auto`: `kind`, `gameId`, `until`. En `moderator_action`-hændelse beholder kun `{ action }`, for handlingerne `ban`, `unban`, `reset_mfa`, `verify_email` og `revoke_sessions` (moderatorernes andre handlinger er udeladt). Alle andre typer har `detail: null`. Hændelserne `rating_refund` er udeladt: deres point står i `ratingRefunds`.
